narrative.overview: The portfolio is a cinematic evidence system. Astronomy remains the original cosmic keynote; each opt-in identity changes the material, interface grammar, display voice, and scroll choreography without changing any project fact or route.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed pinned scenes driven by scroll position.
One unmistakable interface metaphor per identity.
Repository-backed proof and explicit boundaries in both languages.
Large typographic propositions paired with tactile system geometry.

rules.name: The Shared Truth Rule
rules.body: A world may reinterpret presentation, never evidence, status, route structure, or language parity.

rules.name: The Native Frame Rule
rules.body: Reuse facts and routes, not the astronomy frame or another identity's composition.

rules.name: The Material Depth Rule
rules.body: Hardware may hinge, pages may turn, and albums may spin; motion must express the chosen object rather than decorate the viewport.

rules.name: The Identity Geometry Rule
rules.body: A signature shape belongs to its own world and must not become a global decoration.

dos: Do verify every figure and status against the corresponding repository.
Do preserve equivalent English and Arabic facts, focus behavior, and routes.
Do make the first viewport unmistakably native to its selected identity.
Do keep mobile and reduced-motion versions complete and navigable.
donts: Don't expose private repository URLs, customer data, credentials, or rights-restricted assets.
Don't reuse the astronomy planet scene outside Astronomy.
Don't change project truth to make a stronger visual claim.
Don't use monospace as a generic technical costume.
